high_level_description: The image shows a square ceramic tile with a vibrant and colorful design. The background of the tile is a deep blue, which serves as a striking contrast to the bright yellow and light blue flowers painted on it. Each flower has a detailed center that resembles a sunflower, with a textured pattern in shades of brown and orange. The petals of the flowers are painted in alternating shades of yellow and light blue, creating a visually appealing pattern. The flowers are connected by green, leafy stems and branches, which are also painted in a lighter shade of green.
